description: This file defines the class `Zend_Validate_EmailAddress` which provides validation logic for email addresses including format, hostname validation, MX record checking, and local part validation within the Zend Framework's validation package.

classes.name: Zend_Validate_EmailAddress
classes.description: A validator class for email addresses supporting format, hostname, MX record, and local part validation, with configurable options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes validation options, supports Zend_Config or array options.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Returns the current configuration options for the validator.

methods.name: setOptions
methods.description: Sets multiple options at once, including messages, hostname validator, MX check, deep check, and domain check.

methods.name: setMessage
methods.description: Sets a custom validation failure message for a specific key.

methods.name: getHostnameValidator
methods.description: Returns the hostname validator object used for hostname validation.

methods.name: setHostnameValidator
methods.description: Configures the hostname validator object and allowed hostname types.

methods.name: validateMxSupported
methods.description: Checks if DNS MX record query functions are supported on the system.

methods.name: getValidateMx
methods.description: Returns whether MX record validation is enabled.

methods.name: setValidateMx
methods.description: Enables or disables MX record validation.

methods.name: getDeepMxCheck
methods.description: Returns whether deep MX checks are enabled.

methods.name: getDomainCheck
methods.description: Returns whether domain validation is enabled.

methods.name: _isReserved
methods.description: Checks if the provided hostname or IP address is within reserved or private network ranges.

methods.name: _toIp
methods.description: Converts a binary string to an IP address array.

methods.name: _validateLocalPart
methods.description: Validates the local part of the email address (before '@') for correct format.

methods.name: _validateMXRecords
methods.description: Checks DNS MX records for the hostname if MX validation is enabled.

methods.name: _validateHostnamePart
methods.description: Validates the hostname part of the email, including DNS resolution.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Main method implementing RFC2822 compliance check, validating the entire email address.
